moments.text: Infrared view: a small white-hot spot stays near the centre-left as grey clouds stream past; the overlay crosshair and N marker wander about the frame.
The video cuts to a closer, grainier view: the spot is larger and briefly trails a faint tail; clouds keep sliding past behind it.
The picture flickers through blank grey, black and white frames for about half a second.
The spot returns larger and blocky, drifting around the frame and at times stretched diagonally; a black box covers part of the top edge.
The picture shifts off-centre with black areas along the edges; the spot drops out at the bottom edge and shows only in brief glimpses.
Full picture again: the spot, now smaller, roams around the lower half of the frame.
The spot starts trailing a faint short streak behind it as it moves across the frame.
A square box appears around the crosshair and moves about the frame; the streaking spot passes in and out of it.
The picture flashes black, then white and grey, for a few frames.
The spot is faint and blurred, a pale smudge drifting around the frame that is hard to pick out.
The spot sharpens into a small bright dot with a dark edge, held near the centre as clouds pass, until the end.
